title: 2025年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 New York's Eleven Madison Park has become the first vegan( 素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars.

P2 The fine dining establishment received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 when the menu was famed for its fancy animal-based dishes.

P3 However, last year, the restaurant's co-owner and famous chef, Daniel Humm, made the bold decision to remove meat from the menu, citing our unsustainable food system. While cow milk is still served for tea and coffee, the menu is almost 100 percent vegan.

P4 At the time, Humm acknowledged the move was risky, admitting that "it wasn't clear if guests would come", but called the gamble "a risk worth taking."

P5 "In view of the climate crisis, I didn't want to open the same restaurant," Humm told the Financial Times in an interview. "If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors" for others to follow.

P6 Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining'.

P7 "We took the jump to transform Eleven Madison Park into a plant-based fine dining restaurant knowing in our hearts this is what we believed in," stated Humm on Instagram. "Last night, we were honored to be awarded three Michelin stars for the 11th year in a row. I am so grateful to the team members who contributed through its nearly 25-year history. We are also grateful to our guests and partners who believed in our vision and encouraged us to push harder."

P8 Three Michelin stars is the highest award, given to chefs who are at the peak of their profession. "Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics," reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world.

P9 "I think luxury companies have a real role to play and a responsibility," says Humm. "The more creative we are, the more beautiful and delicious our future will be."

questions.q: What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park?
options: It is the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating.
It is the first restaurant in the city to remove meat from its menu.
It was famed throughout the U.S. for its fancy regional dishes.
It was established as a three-star Michelin restaurant in 2011.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park? 问的是关于某对象的客观信 息，没有 infer/imply 等推断信号，属典型细节题。

【拆句】What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park? 是一句结构平铺直叙的特殊 疑问句，learn about 后跟宾语，无陷阱。

【定位】New York's Eleven Madison Park has become the first vegan(素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars. 纽约的 Eleven Madison Park 成为首家获颁米其林三星的素食餐厅。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 the first vegan(素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars ↔ the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating It is the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating. 完整覆盖了预 判的三要素，首家、素食、最高评级，且无任何额外信息，与定位句一一对应。 B) 偷换概念 原文说的是首家获三星的素食餐厅，the first restaurant in the city to remove meat from its menu 把首家偷换到了全市首家撤肉上，原文并无此说。 C) 无中生有 原文 famed for its fancy animal-based dishes 说的是过去以荤菜闻名，famed throughout the U.S. for its fancy regional dishes 一改 animal-based 为 regional （地方菜），二加范围 throughout the U.S.（全美），都无原文支持。 D) 偷换概念 原文 received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 说的是 2011 年首次获三 星，established as a three-star Michelin restaurant in 2011 把获评偷换成建立，与 原文 its nearly 25-year history 也矛盾。 Daniel Humm为什么决定从他的餐厅菜单中去除肉类？ A) 为了鼓励更多顾客选择纯素饮食。 B) 为了促进可持续食品系统的发展。 C) 为了展示植物性菜单的吸引力。 D) 为了争取米其林三星评级。

questions.q: Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant?
options: To encourage more customers to be vegan.
To contribute to a sustainable food system.
To show the appeal of a plant-based menu.
To strive for the three-star Michelin rating.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant? 用 Why 直接问原因，对应原文必有显性的原因表述。

【拆句】Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant? 主 干为 Why did X decide to do Y，decide to 后接动作，无修饰陷阱。 47. Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant? A) To encourage more customers to be vegan. B) To contribute to a sustainable food system. C) To show the appeal of a plant-based menu. D) To strive for the three-star Michelin rating.

【定位】However, last year, the restaurant's co-owner and famous chef, Daniel Humm, made the bold decision to remove meat from the menu, citing our unsustainable food system. 然而，去年餐厅的联合所有者兼名厨 Daniel Humm 做出了大胆决定，将肉从菜单中撤下， 理由是我们的食物体系不可持续。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 To encourage more customers to be vegan. 把动机应对不可持续体系偷换成鼓励顾 客吃素，原文 Humm 的关注点是体系层面而非顾客饮食选择。 B) ✓ 正确 citing our unsustainable food system ↔To contribute to a sustainable food system. 四个选项中只有 To contribute to a sustainable food system. 含 sustainable 这个原 文核心词根，且其表达的目的与 citing 的事实方向自洽。 C) 答非所问 If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors 是 Humm 对该决定后续效果的展望，而非他做决定的原因，时间 和因果关系都被改写。 D) 与原文相反 三星米其林是撤肉之后才获得的结果，To strive for the three-star Michelin rating. 把 它说成做决定的目的，因果关系与原文相反。 Daniel Humm如何看待他转向无肉菜单的举措？ A) 这是一次值得的尝试，尽管他对其成功与否并无把握。 B) 这将为更多餐厅树立榜样。 C) 这是一次疯狂的冒险，很少有高级餐饮界的厨师敢于尝试。 D) 这将被证明是当今餐饮业正确的一步。

questions.q: What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu?
options: It was a worthwhile effort even though he was unsure of its success.
It would set a model for many more restaurants to follow.
It was a mad gamble few chefs in the fine dining world would risk taking.
It would prove a right step to take in today's catering business.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu? 问的是 Humm 自己 怎么看，原文必有他直接表态的引语。

【拆句】What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu? think of 是固定搭 配，意为对...的看法，主干清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】At the time, Humm acknowledged the move was risky, admitting that "it wasn't clear if guests would come", but called the gamble "a risk worth taking." 当时 Humm 承认此举有风险，承认不清楚客人是否还会来，但他把这场赌博称作一次值得 冒的险。 48. What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu? A) It was a worthwhile effort even though he was unsure of its success. B) It would set a model for many more restaurants to follow. C) It was a mad gamble few chefs in the fine dining world would risk taking. D) It would prove a right step to take in today's catering business.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 it wasn't clear if guests would come ↔he was unsure of its success a risk worth taking ↔a worthwhile effort It was a worthwhile effort even though he was unsure of its success. 用 even though 把值得与不确定连起来，恰好对应原文 but 引出的双面态度。 B) 答非所问 It would set a model for many more restaurants to follow. 是 Humm 在 it can open a lot of doors 中说的对外效用，而非他对自己这一举动的内心评价。 C) 过度推断 a mad gamble few chefs in the fine dining world would risk taking 用 mad、few chefs would risk 把原文的 risky 与 a risk worth taking 夸大成几乎没人敢冒的疯狂赌 博，原文 Humm 并未做此横向比较。 D) 偷换概念 It would prove a right step to take in today's catering business. 把 Humm 对自己 这一步的个人评价换成对整个餐饮业的判断，且 a right step 也比 a risk worth taking 多了行业普遍正确的隐含。 米其林2022年纽约指南对Eleven Madison Park餐厅的决定有何评价？ A) 它将该餐厅的烹饪提升到了艺术形式的高度。 B) 它证明了米其林所授予评级的有效性。 C) 它展现了对未来高级餐饮的大胆远见。 D) 这是将该餐厅转变为奢华餐厅的努力。

questions.q: What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision?
options: It elevates the restaurant's cooking to an art form.
It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin.
It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining.
It is an effort to transform the restaurant into a luxury one.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision? 问指南说了什么，对应原文必有指南的引语或转述。

【拆句】What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision? say about 后接讨论对象，结构线性、无陷阱。

【定位】Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining'. 如今，这一令人瞩目的新成就印证了 Eleven Madison Park 撤肉、拥抱植物饮食的决定； 米其林 2022 纽约指南将其誉为奢华餐饮的大胆愿景。 49. What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision? A) It elevates the restaurant's cooking to an art form. B) It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin. C) It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining. D) It is an effort to transform the restaurant into a luxury one.

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 It elevates the restaurant's cooking to an art form. 取自 Their cooking is elevated to an art form，而那是米其林对三星厨师的总体描述，不是 2022 纽约指南对 Eleven Madison Park 这个决定的表态。 B) 与原文相反 It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin. 把指南怎么说决定颠倒为决定 证明了米其林评级的有效性，原文 validates 的对象是 decision，而不是评级。 C) ✓ 正确 a bold vision of luxury dining ↔a daring foresight regarding future fine dining It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining. 同时给出大胆远见与高 端、未来餐饮两个要素，且整体语气与原文引号短语一致。 D) 无中生有 It is an effort to transform the restaurant into a luxury one. 把指南的评价改成餐厅 的主观努力（an effort to），且新增把餐厅变成奢华餐厅这一目的，原文从未提及。 米其林授予Eleven Madison Park餐厅三星表明了什么？ A) 对纯素食品成为主流的乐观愿景。 B) 烹饪界要承担的更大责任。 C) 对更多餐厅向顾客提供更健康食品的强烈激励。 D) 对提供纯素食品的餐厅日益增长的重要性的明确认可。

questions.q: What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate?
options: An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream.
A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake.
A strong incentive for more restaurants to offer healthier foods to their customers.
An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate? 中 的 indicate 是推断题专属信号词。

【拆句】What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate? 主 干为 What does X indicate，X 是动名词短语 the awarding of...，结构清晰、无陷阱。

【定位】"Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics," reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world. 米其林官网写道：他们的烹饪被提升为一种艺术形式，他们的部分菜肴注定将成为经典；这 是对植物饮食在烹饪界日益增长的重要性的明确认可。 50. What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate? A) An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream. B) A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake. C) A strong incentive for more restaurants to offer healthier foods to their customers. D) An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods.

【选项】A) 过度推断 An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream. 把地位上升（rising importance）推到成为主流（becoming mainstream），且加上乐观愿景，跨度超过 原文一步可达的范围。 B) 答非所问 A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake. 取自 luxury companies have a real role to play and a responsibility 这种 Humm 的呼吁，而非 授星事件本身所表明的含义。 C) 偷换概念 A strong incentive for more restaurants to offer healthier foods to their customers. 一把素食或植物偷换成更健康的食物（healthier foods），二把地位上升变 成激励更多餐厅，原文从未谈健康层面，也未谈对其他餐厅的激励效应。 D) ✓ 正确 in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world ↔ An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods. An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods. 仅把植物饮食地位上升在表达载体上落到提供素食的餐厅，恰是从授星事件能合 理外推的一步，无超过原文的判断。
